    "limit": 10,

    "hasNext": true,
    "hasPrev": false

- `GET /users?page=2&limit=20` → users 21-40

Added the missing DELETE trigger `frames_ad` following the existing pattern:

```sql
-- Sync trigger: DELETE
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS frames_ad AFTER DELETE ON frames BEGIN
  INSERT INTO frames_fts(frames_fts, rowid, name, digest_text, inputs, outputs)
  VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.name, old.digest_text, old.inputs, old.outputs);
END;
```

This matches the pattern used in the UPDATE trigger — it uses FTS5's special `'delete'` command to remove entries from the index when frames are deleted from the main table.
